title: Ridgeline Installation Services Projects at One Job Address: Same-Day Visit Coordination
content:
Under Ridgeline Installation Services, a customer's contracts at the same job address are coordinated as one project when their installers visit on the same day. Four rules follow from that coordination.

1. **One trip charge per address per visit date.** At most one trip charge is posted per job address per visit date across all of the customer's contracts. When one or more trip charges are already posted for that visit date on the customer's contracts sharing the job address, no further trip charge posts for that date, and the one posted is the highest program trip charge among the programs visited.
2. **No-show credits stay per contract.** An installer no-show credit is posted per contract whose visit was missed, since each program's installer is booked separately.
3. **Delay remedies stay per program.** A delay in one program's installation never triggers the delay remedies of another program at the same address unless that program's own installation start is delayed.
4. **Same customer, same address.** The coordination joins only contracts of the same customer that share the job address; contracts at another address are not part of the project.

## Points of judgement (hypothetical project)

A customer holds a kitchen cabinet and countertop contract and a window and door contract at one address, and both installers arrive on the same date.

| What the visit records show for that date | Trip charges for that date | Installer no-show credits |
|---|---|---|
| Both visits could not proceed because the site was not ready | one, that of the program with the higher program trip charge | none |
| A trip charge is already posted on one of the contracts for that date | no further trip charge | none |
| Both installers missed their visits | none | one on each contract |
| One installer missed the visit, the other visit went ahead | none | one, on the contract whose visit was missed |

If the window and door installation start runs late while the kitchen job starts on its original installation date, the delay remedies attach only to the window and door contract.
